procedural_matters: Hearing of Case 02 was reopened based on the request to reopen by ESP 3581.
The panel was changed to include one new member. Ilker Bayindir TUR, IJ was replaced by Anastasia Weinberger AUT, IJ
NOR 4121 was represented by Nhoa Hames Melano.
ESP 3581 was represented by Jon Palou Espinar.
Youssef Akrout, coach NOR 4121, attended the hearing as an observer.
Julian Viciano, Team Leader ESP 3581, attended the hearing as an observer.
Nelson, IJ, member jury, acted as an interpreter for ESP 3581.

ESP 3581 was scored DSQ in the original hearing. Original Hearing 1.NOR 4121 was represented by Nhoa Hames Melano. 2.ESP 3581 was represented by Jon Palou Espinar. 3.Youssef Akrout, coach NOR 4121, attended the hearing as an observer. 4.Julian Viciano, Team Leader ESP 3581, attended the hearing as an observer. 5.Nelson, IJ, member jury, acted as an interpreter for ESP 3581. 6.ESP 3581 requested to present the evidence from tracking device. The request was not accepted as SI 2.1 states 'Boats may be required to carry cameras, sound equipment or positioning equipment as specified by the Organising Authority. Information from this equipment shall not be used by a boat as evidence in a hearing. This changes RRS 63.4(b).'
facts: In race 2 wind was 9-10 knots and sea choppy.
NOR 4121 on starboard and ESP 3581 on port were sailing close-hauled on converging course, 5 boat lengths from the windward mark.
NOR 4121 bore away to pass astern of ESP 3581.
The minimum distance between the boats was 10 cm.
ESP 3581 crossed in front of NOR 4121, sailed one and a half boat lengths and tacked to starboard.
The lateral distance between the boats was one boat length after the tack, ESP 3581 to windward of NOR 4121.

In race 2 wind was 9-10 knots and sea choppy.
NOR 4121 on starboard and ESP 3581 on port were sailing close-hauled on converging course, 5 boat lengths from the windward mark.
NOR 4121 bore away to pass astern of ESP 3581.
The minimum distance between the boats was 10 cm.
As NOR 4121 was passing astern of ESP 3581, ESP 3581 luffed, passed head to wind.
Before ESP 3581 got to a close-hauled course, NOR 4121 further bore away.
conclusions: Reopened hearing conclusions: ESP 3581 kept clear of NOR 4121. No rules broken. The Scoring change after reopening - ESP 3581 shall be scored her finishing position in race 2 and all other boats behind her to be scored their finishing positions.
After passing head to wind and before being on a close-hauled course, ESP 3581 failed to keep clear of NOR 4121. ESP 3581 broke RRS 13.
ESP 3581 is DSQ in race 2. Reopening scheduled after racing 29 June.
